Do not use script, style, foreignObject, image, external URLs, event handlers, JavaScript links, embedded HTML, filters, masks, patterns, group opacity or blending. Use direct geometry, solid fills and gradients; avoid clipping effects.
Use a clean academic diagram style with readable labels, balanced whitespace, and a light background.
Hard renderer contract: no shadows of any kind; never output <filter>, <feDropShadow>, <mask>, <pattern>, <clipPath> or filter=, even inside unused defs. If the supplied plan suggests these effects, replace that styling with flat fills and strokes. Use Noto Sans CJK SC / Noto Sans / Noto Sans Math, regular weight and normal style.
Do not include the figure title or caption text inside the SVG.

Create an editable SVG academic diagram from this visual specification.
Use viewBox="0 0 1600 900" for the requested 16:9 aspect ratio. Keep all artwork within this viewBox.
Prefer simple geometric shapes, arrows, concise labels, and semantic grouping.

responseText:
Here is an editable SVG academic diagram for the three-step scientific workflow, ensuring left-to-right layout, clean labels, and compatible flat rendering.
```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1600 900" width="1600" height="900">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="10" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
      <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#808080" />
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="1600" height="900" fill="#FFFFFF" />

  <!-- Step 1: Sample Input -->
  <rect x="150" y="300" width="300" height="200" rx="20" ry="20" fill="#E6F2FF" stroke="#0050B3" stroke-width="2.5" />
  <text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Noto Sans', sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="normal" fill="#000000">样品输入</text>
  <text x="300" y="430" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Noto Sans', sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="normal" fill="#333333">(n=12)</text>

  <!-- Arrow 1 -->
  <line x1="460" y1="400" x2="580" y2="400" stroke="#808080" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)" />

  <!-- Step 2: Normalization -->
  <rect x="600" y="300" width="300" height="200" rx="20" ry="20" fill="#FFF7E6" stroke="#D46B08" stroke-width="2.5" />
  <text x="750" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Noto Sans', sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="normal" fill="#000000">数据标准化</text>
  <text x="750" y="430" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="normal" font-style="italic" fill="#333333">x / x<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="0.75em">0</tspan></text>

  <!-- Arrow 2 -->
  <line x1="910" y1="400" x2="1030" y2="400" stroke="#808080" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)" />

  <!-- Step 3: Result Output -->
  <rect x="1050" y="300" width="300" height="200" rx="20" ry="20" fill="#E6FFE6" stroke="#228B22" stroke-width="2.5" />
  <text x="1200" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Noto Sans', sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="normal" fill="#000000">结果输出</text>
  <text x="1200" y="430" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Noto Sans', sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="normal" fill="#333333">(均值 1.0)</text>
</svg>
```
The figure shows three rounded rectangular steps—sample input, data normalization, and result output—connected by gray arrows from left to right. The layout uses light blue, warm yellow, and light green for the boxes, with Chinese labels and the required sample size, formula, and mean value clearly preserved.
